subject.title: Feature request: per-group debounceMs for WhatsApp (and other channels)

question: Should OpenClaw add a WhatsApp per-group `debounceMs` config override now, and should that be WhatsApp-only or part of a shared channel-group debounce contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix expands user-visible config and changes turn-grouping/latency precedence, which needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add WhatsApp-only override
options.body: Add `channels.whatsapp.groups.<jid>.debounceMs` with explicit precedence over account/channel/global inbound debounce and no cross-channel expansion in the same change.

options.title: Design shared group debounce
options.body: Hold this for a broader channel-group config contract that can cover Telegram, Discord, and other channels consistently.

options.title: Defer the config surface
options.body: Keep using account/channel debounce or routing workarounds until maintainers want another public debounce knob.

recommendation.title: Add WhatsApp-only override
recommendation.body: Add `channels.whatsapp.groups.<jid>.debounceMs` with explicit precedence over account/channel/global inbound debounce and no cross-channel expansion in the same change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original debounce feature and already provided maintainer-facing review on this config-contract question.
